neighbours.label: a startle reaction: someone jumping or being startled by a sudden stimulus
fire: A sudden bang from the kitchen made her jump and drop the cup.
The door slammed and he jumped halfway out of his chair.
Startled by the phone, she spun around in the dark hallway.
The cat leapt sideways, startled by the vacuum cleaner.
When the alarm went off, the old man jumped and grabbed the railing.
Thunder cracked overhead and the children jumped in their beds.
He tapped her shoulder and she jumped with a little scream.
The horse was startled by a plastic bag and bolted.
quiet: A soft song from the kitchen made her smile and lift the cup.
The door opened and he stood up slowly from his chair.
Tired after work, she walked down the dark hallway.
The cat stretched lazily, ignoring the vacuum cleaner.
When the bus arrived, the old man stood and grabbed the railing.
Rain fell gently overhead and the children slept in their beds.
He tapped her shoulder and she turned with a friendly wave.
The horse was calmed by a carrot and stood still.
